Chapter 738: Chapter 27: Two Hundred Years Later (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 738: Chapter 27: Two Hundred Years Later (Please Subscribe)

“`

For a Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouse like Lin Yuan, the only treasure of value in the Two-dimensional World is an exotic item.

Of course, the most precious is certainly the Two-dimensional World itself, that is, the ‘White Paper’.

But even Supreme Beings cannot refine that ‘White Paper’.

The powerhouses trapped within naturally wouldn’t harbor any thoughts about it.

As for the exotic item owned by Xueyu Ancient Country… according to Lin Yuan, it was a Blood Rain Tea Tree.

...

However, that Blood Rain Tea Tree had been taken away by several powerhouses who had stepped into the Witch Ancestor Realm nearly a hundred years ago.

The miraculous aspect of the Blood Rain Tea Tree is no secret among the upper echelons of Xueyu Ancient Country.

Upon realization of the value of exotic items within the Two-dimensional World, the Blood Rain Tea Tree would definitely not have been overlooked and was eyed by powerhouses early on.

It was simply beyond Xueyu Ancient Country’s ability to retain.

“Could it be that Xueyu Ancient Country still hides other exotic items?” Lin Yuan grew interested.

When the royal family of Xueyu Ancient Country declared they had a treasure to offer, Lin Yuan naturally thought along these lines.

“So be it.”

“Let’s meet then.”

Having made up his mind, Lin Yuan thought it was only appropriate to see for himself since it concerned an exotic item.

“Yes.”

Zha Ran Gu immediately responded.

“Since the master has agreed to meet, I shall notify them at once.”

Zha Ran Gu respectfully withdrew.

Without Lin Yuan’s permission, even the royal family of Xueyu Ancient Country.

Would not dare to enter the vicinity of Luochuan Gathering Place uninvited.

Over the years, even though Lin Yuan rarely took action, just the occasional demonstration was enough to deter Xueyu Ancient Country.

…

After Zha Ran Gu went to notify the royal family of Xueyu Ancient Country, there was some time before their audience.

Lin Yuan continued to take out the silver mirror and pour his Spirit Will into it.

Hum, hum, hum.

Accompanied by Lin Yuan using up a great amount of Spirit Will.

The silver mirror in front of him gradually revealed its extraordinary nature.

Faint silver radiance began to emerge.

At the same time.

Lin Yuan actually felt an extremely familiar fluctuation.

Spatial fluctuation.

It was purely spatial fluctuation, not involving any Space Rules.

“This is promising.”

Seeing this, Lin Yuan continued to maintain the infusion of his Spirit Will.

Only a powerhouse in the Witch Ancestor Nineteenth Realm could possess such abundant Spirit Will.

If it were someone in the Fifteenth or Sixteenth Realm, they wouldn’t even meet the prerequisite to activate this silver mirror.

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, most of the day had gone by.

Lin Yuan’s brows slightly furrowed.

Maintaining the infusion of Spirit Will, even Lin Yuan was feeling the strain.

If this were to continue, it would likely impact his own strength.

Just as Lin Yuan was contemplating whether to proceed.

Swoosh.

The silver mirror seemed to undergo a qualitative change.

It began to float up slowly.

The surface of the mirror rippled like mercury, creating gentle waves.

“What?”

Lin Yuan looked at the silver mirror floating up before him, a look of shock on his face.

The fact that the mirror was floating did not surprise him.

With his current strength, a full-force burst could also achieve brief levitation.

It was simply a matter of letting one’s blood and qi boil, unleashing a strong life magnetic field, thereby counteracting the force of gravity.

What truly shocked Lin Yuan was the sensation of an independent space contained within the mirror?

The space was not large, just about ten square meters.

But bear in mind, within the Two-dimensional World, there is no concept of spatial depth: everything is two-dimensional, everything is flat.

And now, the space inside the mirror was akin to opening up a three-dimensional space within a two-dimensional plane, a notion utterly inconceivable, right?

“The direct size of my Inner World has reached two point three three one billion miles in radius, and the number of layers in spatial layers exceeds three billion, yet despite this, upon falling into this Two-dimensional World, my Inner World was instantly compressed into a ‘sheet’ of paper, its existence nullified…”

Lin Yuan inwardly marveled.

And now, within the silver mirror, there actually existed a standalone space being maintained.

Should this standalone space return to the Main Universe, and be completely unfolded, how vast would it become?

“Having the space in the mirror certainly does make things more convenient,” Lin Yuan thought to himself, caressing the silver mirror over and over again.

Although the space in the mirror was not large, it was more than enough to hold Lin Yuan’s daily items, especially that pitch-black iron rod which was far too conspicuous to carry on his back.

Now, he could place the iron rod inside it.

Whenever he wanted to use it, he could take it out in an instant.

Furthermore, for Lin Yuan, the silver mirror possessed a crucial ability for safeguarding his life.

If he ever encountered an attack he could not withstand, he could completely hide inside the silver mirror.

As for the silver mirror’s body exposed to the outside… the silver mirror being an exotic item, a Twelve-Star Strange Treasures weapon, within this Two-dimensional World, equates to an indestructible existence.

Even if Supreme Beings were to fall in here, limited by the suppression of the Two-dimensional World, unable to exert their full power, they still could not shake the silver mirror.

“`

“Not bad, not bad at all,”

Lin Yuan heart felt elated. With this silver mirror in his possession, his means had once again become much richer.

“First, I will place the iron rod inside.” With a thought from Lin Yuan, the nearly two-meter long pitch-black iron rod disappeared on the spot, being stored in the spatial area within the silver mirror.

He then also put the bronze compass into it, a strange object that was of great use to Lin Yuan. Normally, he had to constantly pay attention to it when carrying it on his person.

But once it was placed in the space within the silver mirror, he felt much more at ease.

…

It didn’t take long for Lin Yuan to understand the capabilities of the silver mirror.

Members of the imperial family of Xueyu Ancient Country hurriedly arrived.

Coming to pay respects to Lin Yuan was the current emperor of the Xueyu Ancient Country, a middle-aged man with an air of great dignity.

“Greetings to Your Excellency,” said the Xueyu Emperor, followed by several princes and ministers, with profound respect. The young man seated cross-legged in front of them—his mere presence imposed an almost invisible pressure that came from the essence of life itself, causing the group to bear an immense burden as sweat continuously beaded on their foreheads.

“Is this the mysterious powerhouse hidden within our Xueyu Ancient Country?” the Xueyu Emperor swallowed nervously.

The recently concluded battle in the desolate northwestern region of the Xueyu Ancient Country not only spread widely among the powerhouses of the Myriad Clans but also reached the ears of the local power, the Xueyu Ancient Country.

Moreover, the royal family of Xueyu Ancient Country, based on numerous clues, had vaguely inferred that this mysterious powerhouse was none other than this young man before them.

For over a hundred years, a succession of unparalleled powerhouses emerged from the twelve ancient countries, causing the traditional ruling royal families to tremble with fear.

If it were not utterly necessary, the Xueyu Emperor truly did not wish to approach Lin Yuan because the pressure was too great to bear.

“You may rise,”

Lin Yuan glanced at the respectful figures standing below, pausing slightly on one of them.

That person was the Prince of the Northern Town of Xueyu Ancient Country. Initially, Lin Yuan’s acquisition of the bronze compass could be considered somewhat fated due to the prince’s involvement.

Had the Northern Town Prince not been pursuing the Cloud Mountain Eighteen Bandits, they would not have fled around the Luochuan gathering area.

Even if Lin Yuan had set out to claim the bounty, he wouldn’t have ventured too far from the Luochuan gathering area, and it was very likely he would have missed out on acquiring the bronze compass.

“Even in this two-dimensional world, cause and effect exist, it’s just almost imperceptible,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

In the Xia You Evolution Tower, Lin Yuan had created an incarnation that was comprehending the Cosmic Aurora, rapidly enhancing his understanding of the law of causality.

Now, meeting the Northern Town Prince in such a manner could be considered a manifestation of karma.

“Excellency, these are the treasured items we wish to present,” the Xueyu Emperor took out two wooden boxes.

One box was large, the other small.

The large one was half a meter long, while the small box was only ten centimeters in size.

Zha Ran Gu swiftly approached, taking the two wooden boxes and respectfully placing them in front of Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan opened the two wooden boxes with interest.

Inside the large box was an axe, carved entirely from jade, small and exquisite. A faint sharp aura circulated between the edges of the axe blade.

Inside the small box was a piece of wood. Even without touching it, Lin Yuan could feel a tremendous vitality emanating from within the wood.

“These two treasures…”

Lin Yuan’s expression was unchanged, but his heart was slightly excited.

The small and exquisite jade axe was likely a supreme weapon, similar to the pitch-black iron rod.

And that piece of wood was probably some Twelve-star Rare Treasures material which, if placed in the Main Universe, would likely provoke a Supreme Being to compete for it.

“Xueyu Ancient Country…”

Lin Yuan glanced at the Xueyu Emperor and his retinue below.

Over the past century, the Xueyu Ancient Country must have been scoured by numerous Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses. Even so, they had still managed to retain these two treasures, clearly possessing some means.

“Speak,”

“What do you want me to do?” Lin Yuan asked indifferently.

If the Xueyu Emperor and his entourage had traveled thousands of miles to see him and even presented valuable exotic items, they definitely had a request to make.

“May I ask if Your Excellency is related to the chase that occurred a while back in the northwestern region of the Ancient Country…” the Xueyu Emperor asked cautiously.

“It was me,” Lin Yuan answered directly.

Now, with his power, there was no need to hide the truth; he simply admitted it outright.

“Your Excellency’s power is truly heaven-reaching…” the Xueyu Emperor said with genuine amazement.

The traces left by the great pursuit in the northwestern region had shattered the perceptions of the powerhouses within the Xueyu royal family time and again.

“Just state your business,” Lin Yuan said with a calm voice.

“Yes,”

the Xueyu Emperor composed himself, “I hope Your Excellency will provide protection for our Xueyu Ancient Country…”

“Protection?” Lin Yuan glanced at the Xueyu Emperor.

He had anticipated this request. For indigenous ancient countries in the two-dimensional world, there was bound to be a pervasive sense of panic facing the countless powerful beings descending upon them.

“This is what you’ll do,”

“from now on, you can simply announce to the outside world that I am your protector,” Lin Yuan stated.

“Just like that?” the Xueyu Emperor was somewhat stunned.

“With such an announcement, other powerhouses won’t dare to take any undue action,” Lin Yuan said softly.

Among the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses, news traveled astoundingly fast. Once they learned that the mysterious powerhouse ranked sixth in the standings was protecting the Xueyu Ancient Country, no one with a thousand lives would dare to cause trouble.

“Yes,”

the Xueyu Emperor, though puzzled, dared not show any sign of objection.

…

One month later.

After the Xueyu Emperor returned to the capital and made the announcement,

the Xueyu Empire indeed became much calmer, with the previously unruly powerhouses of the Myriad Clans now significantly subdued.

Many among the Myriad Clans’ Powerhouses unanimously considered Lin Yuan to be a legendary being at Tier 11 Perfection from the Main Universe.

Who would dare to misbehave within the protective scope of such an entity?

Time flew swiftly, and Lin Yuan continued to immerse himself in cultivation; nearly two hundred years flashed by in the blink of an eye.

Only two months remained until the once in ten thousand years opening of the Heavenly Gate.
